query:
WITH user_correct_count AS (
                SELECT
                    g.user_id,
                    u.username,
                    COUNT(*) AS signed_correct_count
                FROM
                    gameEvents AS g
                INNER JOIN
                    users AS u ON g.user_id = u.user_id
                WHERE
                    is_correct = TRUE
                GROUP BY
                    user_id
            )
            SELECT
                user_id,
                username,
                CAST(signed_correct_count AS UNSIGNED) AS correct_count,
                CAST(
                    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signed_correct_count DESC)
                    AS UNSIGNED
                ) AS position
            FROM
                user_correct_count
            ORDER BY position;
